build_llvm: build LLVM for a target platform with parallel compilation jobs
copy_common_generated_files: copy platform-independent LLVM generated files to a destination directory
copy_platform_generated_files: copy platform-specific LLVM generated files with architecture post-processing
copy_platform_file: copy an LLVM config header with platform-specific macro transformations
run_update_script: run the update script to build LLVM and copy generated files for android, linux, darwin, or windows
